variants.headline: State payments fall short
variants.sub: The government has underpaid wages, unemployment benefit and pensions, each by an equal proportion.
variants.body:
The government owed {due} but paid {paid} this month. State wages, unemployment benefit and pensions were each paid short by the same share. For {target}, the immediate question is financial stewardship judged from the position of people whose expected payment has not arrived in full.

A public obligation concerns people, not merely the balance of an account. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Equal cuts, different household needs
variants.sub: Government payments have fallen short across state wages, unemployment benefit and pensions alike.
variants.body:
An equal proportion is not a complete account of a household's needs. State wages, unemployment benefit and pensions have all been paid short by the same share: {paid} was paid against {due} owed. Readers judging {target} should distinguish a uniform reduction from an argument that its burden is therefore easy.

A public obligation concerns people, not merely the balance of an account. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Treasury pays less than it owes
variants.sub: State wages, unemployment benefit and pensions have all been paid short by the same share.
variants.body:
The treasury has paid {paid} against obligations of {due}. The shortfall reaches state wages, unemployment benefit and pensions, each reduced by the same proportion. An assessment of {target} should begin with those unpaid obligations and the ordinary need for a payment to be more than a promise.

A public obligation concerns people, not merely the balance of an account. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
